headline: EPS swings to a profit year-over-year but slips sequentially
summary_short: S-Oil reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩4,420, down 28.6% q/q from ₩6,193 but swinging from a ₩574 per-share loss a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS of ₩4,420 fell 28.6% sequentially from ₩6,193 but swung from a ₩574 per-share loss in the year-ago quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
